Just like the Sun gives light to the whole world, a person named 'सुनील' is expected to illuminate the lives of those around them with their courage, strength, and charitable acts.

historical_references.context: Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. It is a narrative of the Kurukshetra War, a contest between two groups of cousins, the Pandavas and the Kauravas, over the throne of Hastinapura. Sunil is a name of one of the warriors on the Pandava side.
